title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature will allow yantraverse to parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling developers to handle complex requests and improve overall framework usability. It will provide a robust way to extract data from requests, making it easier to build APIs and web applications. This feature is essential for a production-ready framework
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the framework can correctly parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, and handle errors without crashing
reason: This feature is high-impact as it addresses a critical need for request body parsing, and is well-scoped to fit within the 100-250 lines of code criteria, making it a key addition to the framework's production readiness
